+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AWS_REGION = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")
+AWS_SECRETS_MANAGER_HOST = f"secretsmanager.{AWS_REGION}.amazonaws.com"
+
+
+def _pick_secret_id(args: list[str]) -> str:
+    if len(args) > 1 and args[1]:
+        return args[1]
+    secret_id = os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ID")
+    if secret_id:
+        return secret_id
+    raise SystemExit("missing secret id: pass argv[1] or set AWS_SECRET_ID")
+
+
+def _pick_version_id(args: list[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if len(args) > 2 and args[2]:
+        return args[2]
+    return os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_VERSION_ID")
+
+
+def _pick_version_stage(args: list[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if len(args) > 3 and args[3]:
+        return args[3]
+    return os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_VERSION_STAGE")
+
+
+def read_secret_value(secret_id: str, version_id: Optional[str] = None, version_stage: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    endpoint = f"https://{AWS_SECRETS_MANAGER_HOST}/"
+    headers = {
+        "Content-Type": "application/x-amz-json-1.1",
+        "X-Amz-Target": "secretsmanager.GetSecretValue",
+    }
+    payload = {"SecretId": secret_id}
+    if version_id:
+        payload["VersionId"] = version_id
+    if version_stage:
+        payload["VersionStage"] = version_stage
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    if "SecretString" in data:
+        return data["SecretString"]
+    if "SecretBinary" in data:
+        return data["SecretBinary"]
+    raise RuntimeError("secret value not found in response")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    secret_id = _pick_secret_id(sys.argv)
+    version_id = _pick_version_id(sys.argv)
+    version_stage = _pick_version_stage(sys.argv)
+    if version_id and version_stage:
+        raise SystemExit("specify either a secret version id or a staged value, not both")
+    value = read_secret_value(secret_id, version_id=version_id, version_stage=version_stage)
+    sys.stdout.write(value)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+VAULT_API_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("VAULT_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.vaultproject.io")
+VAULT_TOKEN = os.environ.get("VAULT_TOKEN")
+VAULT_SECRET_PATH = os.environ.get("VAULT_SECRET_PATH")
+
+
+def retrieve_secret() -> str:
+    if not VAULT_TOKEN:
+        raise RuntimeError("VAULT_TOKEN is required")
+    if not VAULT_SECRET_PATH:
+        raise RuntimeError("VAULT_SECRET_PATH is required")
+
+    url = f"{VAULT_API_BASE_URL.rstrip('/')}/v1/{VAULT_SECRET_PATH.lstrip('/')}"
+    response = requests.get(
+        url,
+        headers={"X-Vault-Token": VAULT_TOKEN},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    if isinstance(payload, dict):
+        data = payload.get("data")
+        if isinstance(data, dict):
+            if "value" in data and isinstance(data["value"], str):
+                return data["value"]
+            if "secret" in data and isinstance(data["secret"], str):
+                return data["secret"]
+            if "json" in data and isinstance(data["json"], str):
+                return data["json"]
+            if "data" in data and isinstance(data["data"], str):
+                return data["data"]
+
+    if isinstance(payload, str):
+        return payload
+
+    raise ValueError("Secret response did not contain a retrievable secret string")
+
+
+def parse_json_secret(secret_text: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    raw = retrieve_secret() if secret_text is None else secret_text
+    parsed = json.loads(raw)
+    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
+        raise ValueError("Secret JSON must decode to an object")
+    return parsed
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(parse_json_secret(), sort_keys=True))
*** End Patch

+import os
+
+from google.cloud import secretmanager
+
+
+def fetch_api_key() -> str:
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    secret_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_SECRET_MANAGER_SECRET_ID"]
+    version = os.getenv("GOOGLE_SECRET_MANAGER_SECRET_VERSION", "latest")
+    client = secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient()
+    name = f"projects/{project_id}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version}"
+    response = client.access_secret_version(request={"name": name})
+    return response.payload.data.decode("utf-8")
